newsitem.title: USA: U.S to sell $16 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills July 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S to sell $16 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills July 14.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $16 billion of three- and six-month bills on July 14 to raise $1.55 billion as a total of $14.448 billion of bills are maturing.

The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on July 17. The three-month bills mature on October 16 and the six-month bills mature on January 15, 1998.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127942V5 and for the six-month bills is 9127946A7.
